text:
FIELD SURVEY — what makes a good persistent chatbot, who leads, which levers measurably matter, and how the librarian compares BEFORE we tune it. Compiled 2026-08-10 from three parallel research sweeps (consumer products / memory infrastructure / academic literature), synthesized against the librarian as built through ticket the-tenure-loop (PROVED 2026-08-09). Confidence labels kept: numbers below are from ablations or independent audits unless marked vendor-claimed.

== THE THREE CAMPS (and the librarian is in none) ==
1) SUMMARIZE-AND-STUFF (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini): extract facts + maintain a rewritten profile summary, inject into every prompt. No vector DB, no graph (reverse-engineered, confirmed for ChatGPT). OpenAI 'Dreaming V3' (June 2026): a background process continuously REWRITES the profile and auto-corrects staleness ('planned trip' flips to 'past trip'); claimed recall 41.5%->82.8% (self-reported). Staleness was the #1 user complaint driving it. Claude: additive extractive summary, per-Project isolation, user-editable, the only vendor found safety-testing memory-induced sycophancy.
2) MEMORY-IS-CONTEXT-ENGINEERING (Letta/MemGPT, Anthropic dev memory tool): editable in-context blocks + file/tool recall; no hidden semantic layer. Anthropic memory tool + context editing: +39% on 100-turn evals, 84% token cut. Notable adversarial result: bare filesystem+grep scored 74%, BEATING specialized memory systems.
3) KNOWLEDGE-GRAPH EXTRACTION (Zep/Graphiti, Mem0-graph, Cognee; consumer: Nomi 'Mind Map'): LLM extracts entities/relations, hybrid retrieval (vector+BM25+graph+temporal) pulls back. Hybrid retrieval is the converged 2026 default; nobody credible ships pure-vector.
The librarian is a FOURTH thing: the answer comes from the structure itself — the graph walk IS the resolution, inference only supplies nodes on a miss. Nobody surveyed does this; everyone else retrieves memory INTO context and asks the model again.

== THE LEVERS, RANKED BY EVIDENCE STRENGTH ==
1) REFLECTION/CONSOLIDATION — periodic higher-level syntheses written BACK as retrievable memories. Generative Agents ablation d=8.16 (largest clean effect in corpus, arXiv 2304.03442). A-Mem (Zettelkasten-style: new notes link to AND UPDATE old ones, arXiv 2502.12110): multi-hop F1 9.09->39.41 (GPT-4o), 6-7x token cut. COUNTER-FINDING (MemBench, arXiv 2506.21605): reflection-heavy architectures DEGRADE under prolonged interaction while plain retrieval holds — ungated consolidation rots.
2) UPDATE/INVALIDATION IS WHERE MEMORY IS WON OR LOST (arXiv 2606.15903, most rigorous independent study): production failures are dominated by stale/contradicted/wrongly-retained facts, NOT recall — yet benchmarks test recall only. Production audits: 97.8% of 10,134 Mem0 entries junk after 32 days (mem0 issue #4573); benchmark-91.6% collapsing to ~49% effective after 30 days at 38% staleness. LLM-at-mutation-time update logic best (91.7-93.2%) but ~2.3s/case vs 64-191ms deterministic.
3) FORGETTING IMPROVES ACCURACY, not just cost (CURATOR, arXiv 2606.25115): net-value-per-byte pruning drove prompt-injection success 0.75->0, 2.4x memory cut, accuracy ROSE where stale/poisoned memory corrupted answers. Validates lazy decay as an accuracy mechanism.
4) TEMPORAL REASONING is the sharpest replicated differentiator: vector-only ~31% on time-bound questions; '85% of systems failed at least half of time-related queries even when the info existed.' Zep/Graphiti bi-temporal model (event time + ingestion time; valid_from/valid_to/invalid_at) — contradiction INVALIDATES edges, never deletes; history preserved ('what did we believe when' stays answerable). Cheap wins from the LongMemEval paper: fact-augmented key expansion +4-5%, time-aware query expansion +7-11% temporal recall.
5) PROACTIVE MEMORY — the agent bringing things up unprompted. The companion-app signature lever (Nomi: 'you mentioned X — how did it go', pattern-surfacing across mentions; recall from 8+ months unprompted). Task-side numbers: separate agent deciding when to interject +8.3pp Terminal-Bench (arXiv 2607.08716).
6) RETRIEVAL SCORING: recency (exp decay) x importance (LLM-rated at write) x relevance (cosine) — the most-copied scorer (Generative Agents lineage).
7) SELF/PERSONA SPLIT: Nomi 'Identity Core' (the companion's own evolving self-model, reviewer-rated best-in-class consumer memory); Hindsight's four networks — world/bank(own experiences)/opinion+confidence/observation (arXiv 2512.12818, best claimed LongMemEval 91.4%, unreplicated).
8) UNIVERSAL BY 2026 among majors: user-visible/editable memory; scoped isolation (its absence causes identity-blending); incognito modes. Engagement is NOT memory sophistication: Character.AI has primitive memory and massive engagement (17.4-min sessions) — and settled 5 lawsuits Jan 2026 over sycophancy+memory attachment escalation.

== BENCHMARK SKEPTICISM (Law 3 vindicated) ==
The benchmark ecosystem is LOW-TRUST: LoCoMo has ~6.4% ground-truth error (ceiling ~93.6%) yet vendors claim at/above it; Mem0 and Zep BOTH published wrong self-favoring numbers before correcting; MemPalace caught gaming (top_k=50 ~= retrieve everything); LongMemEval-S fits in modern context windows so full-context baselines are competitive. The real case for external memory is cost/latency + cross-session persistence, not benchmark accuracy. CONSEQUENCE FOR US: tune the tenure dials against our own armed probe's live data (standing_moves_under_live_use), never against field numbers.

== WHERE THE LIBRARIAN STANDS ==
AHEAD: the tenure loop sits exactly on lever #2 — the step the field measurably loses on. Provenance-gated deposits + born-hypothesis + earned standing is the structural antidote to the 97.8%-junk failure; crossing honesty (a mint cannot validate itself) exists nowhere else found; lazy decay independently validated (lever #3); answer-from-structure is unique; event-fired everywhere (no daemon) where the field bolts on background processes ('Dreaming V3', Letta sleep-time agents).
VALIDATED BLIND: the uncast ladder rungs map onto the field's biggest levers — consolidation = reflection (lever #1), self tree = Identity Core / persona split (lever #7), warm set = recency channel (lever #6).
BEHIND (honest gaps): (a) CONTRADICTION HAS NO PATH — tenure handles corroboration (attestations) and neglect (decay), but an earned node that becomes WRONG has no invalidation mechanism; this is the field's #1 production failure, and bi-temporal invalidate-don't-delete fits our decay's existing shape (invalidate-at-read, history preserved). (b) The walk is pure cosine — no recency/importance channel, no time-aware query handling. (c) No proactive surface — but the firing event already exists (below).

== THE SURFACE ANSWER (Akien's 'ask me again' vs 'I have something new for you') ==
Not a phrasing choice — two moments of ONE mechanism. First touch: UNRESOLVED-'learned' -> 'still learning, ask me again' (built). When a LATER crossing resolves/promotes what an earlier turn left learned, THAT resolution event — the same one promotion already rides — is the callback: 'I have something new on the thing you asked about.' No clock, no daemon; the companion-world lever falls out of physics already built. Cheapest outsized win on the board.

== BORROW CANDIDATES (ideas cited, not grafted; for discussion, NOT cast) ==
1) Proactive resolution callback — smallest build, event already fires, the lever users feel as 'it remembers me'.
2) Contradiction/invalidation — arguably the missing fifth tenure behavior, not a new rung; cite Zep/Graphiti bi-temporal design.
3) Consolidation rung — biggest measured lever (d=8.16); MemBench's rot warning is WHY ours must be tenure-gated: a reflection is a deposit, born hypothesis, earns standing like everything else (the degrading architectures lacked exactly this discipline).
4) Warm set with time-aware retrieval — fold the cheap indexing tricks (+4-11%) in when that rung casts.
Status 2026-08-10: presented to Akien; he is holding Fable budget for Friday and design may proceed on Opus from THIS note — the full agent transcripts died with the session; this note is the durable record.
